name: PayNote
description: A document attached to exactly one transaction that governs what should happen with that transaction.

$fail.value: PayNote rejection request must be an object.
Transaction initiated payload must be an object.
Payee assignment payload must be an object.
Payee assignment payload must include payeeRef.
Transaction details update payload must be an object.
Transaction details update payload must include transactionDetails object.

items.name: Emit Payment Completion Lock Change Failed

Emit Transaction Details Update Lock Change Failed

status.description: Current lifecycle state of this PayNote. Expected values include: Pending, Accepted, Initiated, Secured, Completed, Cancelled, Reversed, Rejected, Failed.

amount.description: Amount values associated with this PayNote.

expectedTotal.description: The initially expected total amount in minor units.

finalResolved.description: The final resolved amount for completion, if known.

secured.description: Amount currently secured / under guarantor control.

transactionDetails.description: Transaction attachment information confirmed by the Guarantor.

summary.description: Short explanation of what this PayNote is for.

details.description: Full explanation of the process, conditions, and special rules. Markdown recommended.
